contributions.anchor: Form A 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 3000 -'
contributions.detail: the 2 Form A rows (500 + 2,500) sum to 3,000 = the schedule's own printed total = the cover's Totals for THIS REPORT cell on line 1 ($3000-). The cover's CUMULATIVE cell is 31,610.05 = 28,610.05 'Totals from Last Report' + 3,000, and that opening figure is EXACTLY this officeholder's 2020 closing cumulative - an account carried across cycles - so the schedule is period-scoped and the pre-2024 money is not itemized here (and must never be read off the cumulative column as 2024 fundraising).

escalation_note: 700-900 dpi tight crops: amount-column strips on p2 and p3 to establish the band structure below the header; --value cell crops at p2 row 2 (reproduces '5 slashed-0 slashed-0 -'), p2 row 3 ('2,5 slashed-0 slashed-0 -'), p3 row 2 ('$783 superscript-76 -') and the p2 schedule total cell ('3 slashed-0 slashed-0 slashed-0 -'); plus two 900 dpi crops of the p2 name and address columns to settle the handwritten donor names and city/state. No arithmetic dispute arose - both sides close to the printed anchor on the first read.

2.measure_note: ROTATED landscape sheet, but rotated the OPPOSITE way from the 2022 archive sheets: here the sheet's top edge is the image's LEFT edge, so the row index INCREASES as x INCREASES (rows advance left-to-right; on the 2022 sheets they advance right-to-left). Printed ROW rules are the page's vertical rules; rowbands detected 27 of them, 8.22..90.57. The FIRST detected rule (8.22) is NOT a table rule - it is the filer's handwritten underline beneath his '8 APR 24' annotation outside the table, confirmed on a 700 dpi crop - so the table's outer border is 10.76 and the header row ('Amount | Address | Name of Contributor | Date', all single-line) is [10.76,13.85]. Row 1 is the SHADED grey strip immediately below the header (an empty printed row the scan renders grey, not an entry - the convention set by record d0df0309); the filer's two entries are therefore rows 2 and 3. Constant ~3.2 pct pitch throughout; nothing extrapolated. Column bands measured with coverage restricted to the table's own x-extent (7.72 / 17.79 / 57.49 / 85.89 / 93.50). PROVED with 900 dpi --value crops at rows 2 and 3, which reproduce the two amounts.

3.measure_note: Same rotated-landscape geometry as p2. 27 vertical rules detected, 8.16..93.80; as on p2 the first (8.16) is the filer's handwritten '8 APR 24' underline outside the table, so the table border is 10.73. The header row here is much TALLER than one pitch - [10.73,18.02], 7.29 pct - because Form B's first column header 'Date of Expenditure' wraps to three printed lines; verified on a 700 dpi crop showing the 'Amount' header occupying that whole band. Row 1 is the shaded grey strip below it and the filer's single entry is row 2. Constant ~3.14 pct pitch below that; nothing extrapolated. Column bands measured with restricted coverage (6.27 / 16.32 / 34.07 / 44.10 / 86.80 / 94.44). PROVED with a 900 dpi --value crop at row 2, which reproduces $783.76.

expenditures.note: date kept VERBATIM as the filer wrote it ('2 Jan. ’24'); it is not one of the two shapes the build normalizes (M/D/YY(YY), D-Mon-YY), so it will surface as unparseable rather than be repaired here. The amount is written '$783' with a superscript '76' - i.e. 783.76 - matching the schedule's own printed total '783 . 76'. notes: HANDWRITTEN blue-ink 2024 3-line form, three pages: p1 cover ('7 days before convention' box ticked, signed 8 April 2024), p2 FORM A, p3 FORM B - form order and page order agree. The county REDACTED the candidate's street address and cell phone on the cover before publishing (black bars); nothing behind that redaction was recovered or inferred. OFFICEHOLDER ACCOUNT: the cover's 'Totals from Last Report' column (28,610.05 / 21,218.46 / 7,391.59) is this filer's 2020 CLOSING cumulative, so both schedules itemize the PERIOD only and the cumulative column double-counts the 2020 cycle - this is why both sides are period-exact rather than exact. Neither schedule prints a per-page subtotal; each prints one grand total at the foot and both close to the cent (Form B) or to the dollar as written (Form A) against the cover. No in-kind items are labelled. Donor street addresses / PO box on Form A are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md: city/state only).
